before.name: Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) - Part 1 (IIA - 2025 Syllabus)
before.description: Part 1 of the CIA exam tests the fundamentals of internal auditing, governance principles, and ethical conduct based on the Global Internal Audit Standards. Questions should test the candidate's knowledge of the IIA Code of Ethics, internal control frameworks, and the proper scope/role of the internal auditor.
